observations.bounded_observation: Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Diadem EEG 12ch as a wearable mobile dry-EEG headset optimized for estimation of emotional and cognitive states.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Air EEG 8ch as a wearable mobile dry-EEG device optimized for estimation of basic cognitive and emotional states.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Hero EEG 9ch as a wearable wireless dry-EEG system optimized for cognitive and sensorimotor-state estimation.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Ikon EEG 5ch as a wearable smart-textile EEG device for real-world brain monitoring.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Ikon Sleep EEG as a wearable EEG device for sleep applications.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Versatile Plus as a water-based EEG system with multiple channel configurations; exact OFFERING-versus-CONFIGURATION treatment remains unresolved.
Current Bitbrain catalogue and download centre preserve multiple Versatile EEG channel configurations; exact OFFERING-versus-CONFIGURATION treatment remains unresolved.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Versatile Kids EEG with 16- and 32-channel configurations; exact OFFERING-versus-CONFIGURATION treatment remains unresolved.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Versatile Bio Amplifier as a physiological biosignal amplifier; NeuroAI scope is not established by this source alone.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Ring Biosignal GSR BVP for electrodermal and cardiac monitoring; NeuroAI scope is not established by this source alone.

Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies SennsLite as software for visualization, collection and synchronization across Bitbrain sensor products; independent PRODUCT/OFFERING treatment remains unresolved.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies SDK Software for data acquisition and programming; independent PRODUCT/OFFERING treatment remains unresolved.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies SennsLab as experimental-design and synchronized data-collection software with cognitive and emotional biometrics available through a plugin.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies SennsMetrics as a SennsLab extension providing emotional, cognitive and behavioral metrics; independent PRODUCT/OFFERING treatment remains unresolved.
Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies IRT Online as a software/tool offering for implicit-response testing; NeuroAI scope and independent PRODUCT/OFFERING treatment remain unresolved.

Current Bitbrain catalogue identifies Bitbrain Human Behaviour Research Labs as a scientific platform for measuring cognitive, emotional and behavioral processes; exact product/service boundary remains unresolved.
